summary: The classifySdkSkill code change is sound, but the feature did not complete the required desktop regression coverage: the contracted office-cli baseline was missing, and there is no evidence that the hot-reload or listSkills-failure scenarios were actually exercised.

issues.description: The feature was marked successful without satisfying its contracted BYOK verification baseline. The feature spec requires `~/.factory/skills/office-cli/SKILL.md` and a reply containing `office-cli`, but the handoff itself records that `office-cli` was not installed and the manual check instead relied on a different skill set.
issues.evidence: features.json:657,662 require the office-cli precondition/result; .factory/library/environment.md:48 and .factory/library/user-testing.md:79 repeat the same baseline; handoff 2026-04-22T03-24-10-370Z...json (lines 93-100 in the file excerpt) states office-cli was missing but still reports success.
issues.suggestedFix: Do not mark the feature complete until the office-cli precondition is restored or the validation contract is updated to the actual installed skill set and the desktop BYOK regression is re-run against that approved baseline.

issues.description: The feature description explicitly assigns VAL-SKILLS-013 hot-reload and VAL-SKILLS-014 listSkills-failure fallback verification to m1-f4, but the transcript/evidence only show a single `你有什么技能` run. There is no trace of creating `__val_tmp_skill__`, observing `slash_commands_updated`, or forcing a `listSkills()` rejection path.
issues.evidence: features.json:663,669 require the hot-reload and failure-path checks plus screenshot/console/IPC artifacts; grep for `__val_tmp_skill__|VAL-SKILLS-013|VAL-SKILLS-014` in worker-transcripts.jsonl returned no matches; the evidence directory contains only `m1-f4-evidence-byok-reply-top.png` and `m1-f4-evidence-byok-reply-bottom.png`.
issues.suggestedFix: Run the two missing desktop scenarios explicitly: (1) add/remove `~/.factory/skills/__val_tmp_skill__/SKILL.md` and capture the `slash_commands_updated` evidence, and (2) execute the documented listSkills-rejection harness/failure path and archive the console + IPC log proving fallback-scanned skills still surface.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared mission/library docs still treat `~/.factory/skills/office-cli/SKILL.md` as the required BYOK verification baseline, but this machine's actual installed skills are `star-office-helper`, `pptx`, `morph-ppt`, `docx`, etc. That mismatch directly affected m1-f4 review/verification.
sharedStateObservations.rationale: Update the shared environment/user-testing guidance so future workers and validators do not silently validate against the wrong local skill inventory.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `droid-backend-worker` Step 3 requires screenshots plus DevTools console and IPC network logs for manual CDP verification, but the archived m1-f4 evidence contains screenshots only. The worker also marked `skillFeedback.followedProcedure` as true.
sharedStateObservations.rationale: Tighten the skill or its checklist so follow-procedure claims require console/IPС artifacts whenever a feature's verificationSteps ask for them.
